description:
The legendary fighting franchise returns with a new live-action adaptation of Street Fighter, bringing iconic warriors like Ryu, Ken, Chun-Li, and M. Bison back to the big screen.

Set in a global underground fighting circuit, warriors from around the world clash in a high-stakes tournament controlled by the mysterious Shadaloo organization. As power, revenge, and destiny collide, the strongest fighters must rise to face an unstoppable evil.

This official trailer showcases intense martial arts action, faithful character designs, and a modern cinematic take on one of the most iconic video game franchises of all time.
